summary: 9F Inc. (NASDAQ: JFU), a Beijing-based digital technology service provider, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited first-half 2026 financial results for the six months ended June 30, 2026, the US-equivalent of an earnings press release. Total net revenues were RMB78.7 million (US$11.6 million), down 48.3% year over year, while net income rose to RMB704.6 million on unrealized gains in wealth management products; adjusted net income was RMB153.9 million. No transaction, stake, or board recommendation is involved; the disclosure concerns operations, liquidity, restricted cash and ongoing litigation.
